records.label: Overview
notes: House Tang and Sword Manor fighting establishments are the aggregate issue authority; exact named personal manifests remain separately owned.
Sword Manor trainee issue stock follows the current registered protective kit; no removed equipment is counted as current stock, production, or destruction.

facts.issued aggregate calculation: All 170,060 permanent House Tang military bodies are covered by their registered role loadouts: 30,000 House elites + 30,060 Sword Manor + 110,000 Four Bastion Corps. Role-specific weapon counts are derived from exact force composition; named personal manifests remain separate custody owners.

records.label: Tang restricted equipment
notes: Reserve quantities are derived from current issue count, 24 months of role-specific normal attrition, a 25% immediate reissue floor, and a 25% disruption contingency on attrition. They are stock targets, never gameplay caps.

facts.assigned mount calculation: Assigned count is derived from all current force_house_tang formations; reserve is the current House Tang remount stock target. No Swift Warhorse category exists.
facts.mount_category_rule: House Tang service cavalry uses the Tang Heavy Warhorse category. Breeding/remount animals support this service category; ordinary riding, draft, pack and chariot animals remain distinct world service pools.

facts.Bow conservation: 75,060 current bow loadouts are derived from exact House Tang, Sword Manor, and Bastion role establishments. Exact named personal manifests remain separate.
facts.Great War Bow calculation: 50,000 current Great War Bow loadouts across House troops, senior/general disciples, and Bastion archers.
facts.separate exact-person bow manifests: owned by exact person/equipment custody records

facts.calculation: Ranged establishment is 75,060 bow loadouts and 18,500 hand-crossbow loadouts at 36 carried missiles each. Strategic reserves use the current House Tang production-policy derivation and mirror the garrison depot rather than duplicating stock.

records.label: Ammunition
notes: Every aggregate standing bow loadout has one 36-arrow quiver. Reserve arrows are physically separate in the garrison depot and do not count as carried ammunition.
